summary: AMC Robotics Corp filed an 8-K on August 17, 2026, announcing Warrant Inducement Agreements with two holders of existing warrants. The holders agreed to cash-exercise 606,060 warrants at a reduced price of $1.65 per share, generating approximately $1 million in gross proceeds, with an option to exercise remaining warrants for up to $1.1 million additional. In exchange, the company issued new Inducement Warrants for up to 1,219,816 shares at an exercise price of $5.7756 (25% premium to prior close), immediately exercisable, expiring in 4.33 years. A resale registration statement must be filed within 30 days and effective within 60 days. The company is restricted from issuing shares for 60 days. This is effectively a private capital raise with warrant incentives, not a conventional capital return program.
